title: Volcanoes of Ethiopia (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Ethiopia, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Dama Ali
rounds.fact: Dama Ali is a shield volcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1631. The data places it in Ethiopia.
